card.title: Count What I Did
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the practical work, time, or inconvenience you contributed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you call that a quick shop, I carried twelve bags up six flights.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I know. Sit down; I'll put everything away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. The frozen peas came up separately. That was a second trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you sit down twice. I'll make tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you tell everyone why I'm getting two rests? Otherwise it looks like one long sit.

mechanism: A seeks acknowledgment of carrying effort and a second trip even while accepting practical care.
confusable: Unlike merely asking for rest, A must make the exact labor publicly recognized.
comparison: D33-a asks others to understand two earned rests; D33-b blocks an easy recommendation from hiding a whole Saturday's work.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
